name: Investigation Location Method 1 Code
definition: Specifies the method used to deliver/retrieve the investigation information.

EDIC.name: Electronic Data Interchange
EDIC.definition: Investigation related data must be sent through Electronic Data Interchange (EDI).

EMAL.name: E Mail
EMAL.definition: Investigation related data must be sent through e-mail.

FAXI.name: Fax
FAXI.definition: Investigation related data must be faxed.

POST.name: Post
POST.definition: Investigation related data must be sent through postal services.

SMSM.name: SMS
SMSM.definition: Investigation related data must be sent through by phone as a short message service (SMS).

URID.name: Uniform Resource Identifier
URID.definition: Investigation related data needs to be sent to a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI). URI is a compact string of characters that uniquely identify an abstract or physical resource. URI's are the super-set of identifiers, such as URLs, email addresses, ftp sites, etc, and as such, provide the syntax for all of the identification schemes.
